gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies that the proposed interpolation in the circle-valued target is ill-defined, that the degree calculation must use lifts, and that the converse implication remains unsupported. Its null-homotopy/classification repair addresses the missing global lift-based converse by an equivalent topological route, although it does not present the gold's exact lift construction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the failure of the converse homotopy classification: the displayed interpolation is not a well-defined operation on R/Z, and equality of winding data requires a valid lift or equivalent null-homotopy argument to produce the homotopy.
gold_decisions.uncovered_gold_detail: No substantive gold concern is left unrecognised; the prediction uses a different null-homotopy repair rather than the gold's explicit global real-lift construction.

component_coverage.gold_component: The displayed circle-valued interpolation is not well-defined because representatives cannot be linearly combined, so it does not establish the converse homotopy.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states that scalar multiplication on R/Z is undefined for nonintegral parameters and concludes that the proposed homotopy and converse are unsupported.

component_coverage.gold_component: Zero winding data alone must be converted into a global lift or equivalent null-homotopy before constructing a homotopy from f to g.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction distinguishes the degree of a circle-valued map from endpoint values of the map itself and proposes proving null-homotopy from all zero winding numbers, then adding that null-homotopy to g; this is an independently complete equivalent repair of the missing lift-based step.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-005 concerns whether a cut point in a general p.c.f. fractal has exactly two itineraries and whether the cut-and-identify construction is defined. It does not diagnose the distinct failure that the shift is imposed on the successor cycle while the theorem prescribes winding on the original cycle, nor does it establish the missing homology/equal-winding relation.
